body:
clone creates any number of instances of a desired abstraction (a patch loaded as an object in another patch). Within each copy, "$1" is set to the instance number. These count from 0 unless the "-s" option sets another start, and the "-x" option leaves "$1" out. You can pass additional arguments to the copies, which appear as $2 and onward (or $1 and onward with the "-x" option).

clone's inlets and outlets correspond to those of the contained patch, and may be signal and/or control inlets and outlets. You can click on the clone object to see the first of the created instances.

Control inlets forward a message to the instance whose number starts it, or use the 'next', 'this', 'set' and 'all' prefixes to pick instances. Signal inlets can get non float messages with the 'fwd' prefix in the same way, but signals are sent to all the instances. Signal outlets output the sum of all instances' outputs, and control outlets forward messages with the number of the instance prepended to them.

For backward compatibility, you can also invoke this as "clone 16 clone-abstraction", swapping the abstraction name and the number of voices.
